secondary_estimands: A8 minus A7 (S_omega marginal effect; controlled companion)
H3: harmful-replacement reduction (descriptive/statistical, no invented threshold)
macro_aggregation_rule: mean over 4 domain-mean deltas (equal domain weight)
group_handling: groups never split; sampled with replacement within stratum
paired_two_sided_p: p_lower=(1+count(D_b<=0))/(B+1); p_upper=(1+count(D_b>=0))/(B+1); p=min(1, 2*min(p_lower,p_upper)); D_b = metric_A(b) - metric_B(b)
multiplicity: primary = raw paired two-sided p; no new multiplicity correction introduced
claim_criterion: non-inferiority claim iff lower 95% CI of macro DeltaDice > -0.005

holdout_bootstrap_plan.reason: the DEV plan (4957) does not cover the 875-row holdout; a holdout plan is generated pre-outcome from the metadata-only group structure under the frozen rule above
